claims.quote: Homalopterula ripleyi is a hillstream loach known only from a small area of northern Sumatra, Indonesia, on the eastern slopes of the Barisan range.
The type locality lies just over the border in Aceh itself and is given by Fowler as 'Goempang River at Meloewak, Atjeh Province, Sumatra, Indonesia, elevation 1640 feet'.

regions.name: Bohorok
regions.quote: The fish were collected from two new localities. The first, in February 2003, was an unnamed tributary of the Sungai (river) Bohorok measuring just 0.5–1.2 m wide and 10–30 cm deep, with the composition and structure of the riparian vegetation suggesting it rarely exceeds 1 m in depth.
